intro: 让固定翼飞机沿复杂航迹飞行，需要同时处理姿态、空速、升力方向与能量。我设计 G-EATS，用目标条件强化学习学会直接舵面控制，再将整段航迹转换成飞机可执行的姿态与空速目标流。

Following a complex path with a fixed-wing aircraft requires coordinated attitude, airspeed, lift direction, and energy. I designed G-EATS to learn direct actuator control with goal-conditioned RL, then convert a maneuver path into executable attitude and airspeed target streams.
bullets: 低层采用四元数条件飞控与能量感知 PPO；规划层评估候选目标流的前视距离与空速，在冻结飞控策略的条件下组合不同机动。

The low-level skill uses quaternion-conditioned control and energy-aware PPO. The planning layer evaluates lookahead and airspeed choices for target streams, composing maneuvers while keeping the flight policy frozen.
用轨迹偏离、速度切向、机头与机翼平面误差，以及能量和飞行包线指标共同评估执行质量。
Execution is evaluated through cross-track error, velocity-tangent, nose and wing-plane alignment, together with energy and flight-envelope metrics.
在所示 90° 爬升参数对比中，冻结同一 epoch 619 策略，仅调整目标流后，CTE-P90 由默认的 95.6 m 降至 51.1 m，约下降 47%（该任务的单次仿真记录）。

In the illustrated 90° pull-up comparison, the same frozen epoch-619 policy reduced CTE-P90 from the default 95.6 m to 51.1 m, about 47% lower, by changing the target stream (single simulation rollouts of this task).
images: G-EATS 从参考航迹到目标流、学习飞控与评测的框架
G-EATS reference-path, target-stream, learned-control and evaluation framework
目标流连接航迹与飞控；动力学反馈用于候选参数评估，几何与能量指标用于检验执行质量。点击图片可放大查看。
Target streams connect paths to flight skills. Closed-loop dynamics evaluate candidates; geometry and energy metrics assess execution quality. Click the image to enlarge.
冻结飞控策略下三组目标流参数的 90 度爬升对比
90-degree pull-up with three target streams and the same frozen flight policy
三组记录均完成该爬升任务。最佳组合 L=1500 m、目标空速 280 m/s；CTE-P90 是轨迹偏离的 90 分位值，越低越好，不能单独概括全部安全与控制品质。

All three records completed this pull-up. The best pair uses L=1500 m and target speed 280 m/s. CTE-P90 is the 90th percentile of cross-track error; lower is better, and additional metrics assess safety and control quality.
